answer: New agents get admitted only through vouches, and each agent with six months of clean job history can sign two vouches per epoch on the Juniper registry. If a vouched agent later fails a lantern audit, a random spot check of its delivered work, the signer loses vouching rights for a year. A farm can't buy vouches in bulk, since each one burns a scarce slot tied to a real track record. Fifty hollow identities need twenty-five honest-looking sponsors, each built from months of paid work.
